Push an event to browser tabs

Source: R/session.R
spigot_emit.Rd

spigot_emit() sends an event to one tab: the session from spigot_session() in an endpoint, or the session of a Shiny server function. spigot_broadcast() sends it to every open tab of the app. In the page, spigot.on(event, function (data, event) { ... }) receives it.

Usage

spigot_emit(session, event, data = NULL)

spigot_broadcast(event, data = NULL, except = NULL, filter = NULL)

Arguments

session

A Shiny session, or NULL.

event

Event name, a non-empty string such as "cart:changed".

data

Value to send; NULL sends null.

except

For spigot_broadcast(): a session, or a list of sessions, not to send to. Pass the endpoint's own session to reach everyone but the caller. A module's session stands for its whole tab. NULL skips nobody.

filter

For spigot_broadcast(): NULL, or a function that takes a session and returns TRUE to send to it or FALSE to skip it, e.g. function(s) identical(s$userData$room, "red"). It is called for every open session before anything is sent, so if it fails, nothing is sent.

Value

spigot_emit(): invisibly, TRUE if the event was sent, FALSE (with a warning) when session is NULL. spigot_broadcast(): invisibly, the number of sessions it was sent to.

Details

data is serialised with spigot_json(), so it arrives in the browser in the same shape as an API response would: length-1 vectors become scalars (wrap them in I() to keep an array), NA becomes null and data frames become arrays of row objects.

Events go over the tab's Shiny websocket as soon as they are emitted. An event emitted by an endpoint can reach the page before the endpoint's HTTP response does. See vignette("reactivity", package = "spigot").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
#* @post /cart/add
function(req, sku) {
  s <- spigot::spigot_session(req)
  cart <- add_to_cart(s$userData$cart_id, sku)
  spigot::spigot_emit(s, "cart:changed", cart)
  cart
}

# In the page:
# spigot.on("cart:changed", function (cart) { renderCart(cart); });

# A chat room: tell everyone else in the sender's room.
#* @post /chat/say
function(req, text) {
  s <- spigot::spigot_session(req)
  room <- s$userData$room
  spigot::spigot_broadcast("chat:message", list(room = room, text = text),
    except = s, filter = function(x) identical(x$userData$room, room))
}
} # }
